name: Don Camillo Pizzeria
kurzbeschreibung:
**Don Camillo Pizzeria in Tirol**

Welcome to **Don Camillo Pizzeria** in the heart of **Tirol**, where authentic Italian flair meets Alpine charm. Indulge in our freshly baked **Pizza Napoletana**, crafted with love using traditional methods. From classic **Margherita** to hearty **Diavola**, each slice is a taste of Italy.

Pair your meal with a glass of fine Italian wine or a cold **Radler** for the perfect balance. Our cozy atmosphere invites you to relax and enjoy the warmth of Italian hospitality in the stunning backdrop of **Tirol**.

Don’t miss our famous **Tiramisu**—a sweet finish to your culinary journey. Whether you’re in **Innsbruck**, **Kitzbühel**, or exploring the **Zillertal**, **Don Camillo Pizzeria** is your go-to for authentic Italian flavors in the mountains.

Come for the food, stay for the experience! 🍕✨
